text: Akbari Baoli (Gujrat Town) Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Akbari Baoli (Gujrat Town) Type: Monument - Baoli (Stepped Well) Province: Punjab District: Gujrat Period: Historic Relative Chronology: 1526 - 1857 CE Description: This is a small baoli in the ruins close to the fort built by Emperor Akbar in 1580 CE. The baoli has a simple brick stair-case descending to a large well under four centered arches. It has platforms at intervals.
